name: New Cosmos Electric
summary: New Cosmos Electric Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, sells, and maintains residential gas and fire alarms, and fixed gas detection and alarm systems in Japan. It offers portable gas detectors, such as combustible gas, oxygen, toxic gas, combined gas, and other detectors, as well as gas detection and alarm systems for industrial use, portable gas detectors, odor level indicators, air quality monitors, etc. The company was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
